primary_metric: mean AP over clean, 10%, 30%, 50% MCAR dropout
prior_art_status: Related missingness-shift adaptation and covariate-shift calibration are established; this focused search did not establish the exact proposal combination as new. Novelty remains unverified.
limitations: This is a three-seed synthetic pilot; the AP increase is very small and not evidence of statistical significance or external validity.

The proposal describes a continuous absolute-error target for logistic regression. The faithful operationalization is fractional Bernoulli logistic loss; hard-label sklearn LogisticRegression cannot directly fit it.
Random MCAR masks are not structured real-world missingness; only mask frequencies at 30% and 60% were used to train the reliability model.
Average Brier score was marginally worse overall (0.064518 vs 0.064486), despite lower error-subset probability spread at 50% missingness in every seed.
The synthetic class prior is stable and the shrinkage target is the training prevalence, as assumed in the proposal.
